title: Basic 4-Channel PCM Flight-Test Telemetry Stream
description: Clean IRIG-106 Chapter 9 TMATS setup defining a 128 kbps NRZ-L PCM stream with 32-bit minor frame sync pattern (FE6B2840), four 16-bit air-data words, and linear polynomial conversions.

title: Subcommutated Thermal & Pressure Instrumentation Frame
description: IRIG-106 TMATS configuration demonstrating major-frame subcommutation (FP/FI) of thermocouple and pressure transducer channels alongside supercommutated pitch rate.

title: Launch Vehicle S-Band PCM/FM Telemetry & Bit-Packed Discretes
description: Launch vehicle S-band RF telemetry TMATS package combining T-1 transmitter RF parameters, M-1 multiplexer routing, high-rate IMU words, and non-overlapping bit-packed staging discretes.

title: High-Rate Wing Flutter Vibration & Strain Gauge Recorder
description: 1.024 Mbps flight-test structural dynamics TMATS configuration recording 8 wing-tip accelerometers and root bending strain gauges with polynomial calibration curves.

title: Flight-Test Instrumentation TMATS & Calibrated PCM Dataset
description: Multi-file IRIG-106 flight-test archive pairing a full G/T/M/P/D/C TMATS setup with a companion calibrated PCM time-series CSV recorded during a supersonic climb maneuver.
